# Carter Houck

> Carter Houck is a New York City based graphic designer, video editor, and event manager specializing in nightlife and hospitality. He works at DND Agency and Nothing Radio, and is available for freelance projects.

Portfolio site for Carter Houck — graphic design, video editing, and event management work for hospitality and nightlife brands.

## About

- [Bio](https://carterhouck.com/bio.html): Full biography, work history, education, and contact information.
- [Feed](https://carterhouck.com/feed.html): Works in progress, personal projects, and ongoing experiments.
